extraction.notes: 2027 Scouts BSA summer camp sessions are indexed on the official registration platform, but those pages returned no readable body when opened. Only explicitly visible 2027 session dates are included; the complete schedule, prices and registration milestones need verification. The main camp website still advertises 2026. Frontier Camp, Eagle Bound and COPE/climbing are described as summer-camp activities rather than separately registered camps and are included in the summer-camp description. Kid Kamporee has 2026 materials but no verified 2027 listing; it is not carried forward because a 2027 summer program listing exists. Registration-platform PDFs could not be accessed from the unreadable event pages.

A Week 1 page exists at https://scoutingevent.com/713-115916-272321, but its dates were not readable; season bounds therefore span only the two verified rows, not necessarily the complete season. Verify all sessions, 2027 youth pricing and registration milestones on the platform. The main website's 2026 prices are retained as fallback.
